definition: [ גֵּל ] noun [masculine] dung ( ball of dung, Arabic etc., dung of camels etc., compare Aramaic גַּלָּא ; on form see Ew § 255 b Ol § 150. 163 ) — suffix גֶּלֲלוֺ Job 20:7 , plural construct הָאָדָם ( צֵאַת ) גֶּלֲלֵי Ezek 4:12 ; Ezek 4:15 — human dung used as fuel Ezek 4:12 ; Ezek 4:15 (צֵאַת) הָאָדָם ׳ ג ; perhaps also Job 20:7 , but compare Di , who thinks no reference to fuel, & De who thinks of cattle-dung; (see on Arabic word Wetzst in De ). — See also II. גָּלָל . גֹּל , גֻּלָּהּ see גֻּלָּה . below
